overview_description.description: Homebase provides revolutionary products made accessible that empower homeowners to buy, sell, and own homes in ways that work best for themselves. Their vision is to actualize each and every individual's dream of homeownership in southeast Asia.  Homebase is backed by leading investors and partners around the world. Their investors and partners include but are not limited to, large global financial institutions, leading venture capital and private equity funds, and successful entrepreneurs and angel investors.

about_short_description.short_description: Homebase is a fintech platform that provides real estate investment and financing solutions for individuals.

product.name: Buy with Installment
product.description: A financing solution allowing customers to purchase real estate with an initial down payment starting at 8% and pay the remaining amount in monthly installments.

product.name: Sell to Homebase
product.description: A service that allows property owners to sell their real estate quickly to Homebase and receive payment within 72 hours.

identifier.value: Unlock Equity (Khai thác vốn sở hữu)

product.name: Unlock Equity (Khai thác vốn sở hữu)
product.description: A financial solution enabling property owners to convert up to 80% of their property's value into immediate cash without selling the asset.

product.name: Growth With Homebase Program
product.description: A partnership program for credit officers, real estate agents, and freelancers to earn commissions by referring clients to Homebase.
